findings.detail: The all-PIK position has a source coupon of 13.00% PIK but the X02 population reports a missing interest rate/basis spread.
Many other flagged rows explicitly report N/A(6) for rate and have zero principal with small adjustment values, so X02 also over-scopes non-rate-bearing components.

rationale: Class 2 aggregate of row-local X02 warnings. Raw schedule evidence localizes a genuine defect: table 12 row 30 states a 13.00% PIK coupon for Any Hour, LLC, while X02 identifies missing interest-rate/basis-spread records. Under the platform all-in convention, an all-PIK coupon must populate interest_rate. The same source also shows many N/A(6), zero-principal adjustment rows (for example table 12 row 24), indicating that the 261-row batch is mixed and includes rule-scope false positives; escalation is warranted for row-wise remediation rather than treating every warning as defective.
